problem_statement:
Featured Image from Google Library wasn't added


#### Steps to reproduce
1. Starting at URL: https://wordpress.com/post/
2. Click on "Set Featured Image"
3. Select the option "Photos from your Google library" (connect to Google if necesary) 
![photos from your google library](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3696121/39901035-903bb366-548b-11e8-97a4-966e20bb6c6a.png) 
4. Click on "Set Featured Image" and Publish the post. The preview will not display a Featured Image and when trying to close the recently published post you will get this message 

> You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave this page?

#### What I expected
To have a new post with its featured image on it

#### What happened instead
I have a new post without a featured image (need to add it again so it gets applied)

#### Browser / OS version
Google Chrome 66.0.3359.139 / macOS High Sierra

#### Context / Source


This was tested on different themes, so it is not a theme issue. This was first reported here #1150882-zen and I was able to replicate it on a test site.
